entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this VeloBand Pulse thing.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have your order number handy?
I guess. Hold on. It's VF88602.

Thank you. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor, delivered on December 31st. To get started, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
I just don't like it. The whole interface is just... hard to use.
I'm sorry to hear that. Can you tell me what part you're finding confusing? Sometimes a few settings can make all the difference.
Look, I read the user manual. It's not me. I expected more from it, and it's not delivering. I just want to send it back.
I understand completely. No problem at all. Let me just confirm the policy here... one moment.
Okay, yes. I see you received the item 12 days ago. Our system shows that items are eligible for return within 90 days, so you're well within that timeframe.
Fine. So what do I do?
I've just approved the return for you. I'm sending a prepaid shipping label to the email we have on file. You just need to print it, attach it to the box, and drop it at a post office.
Whatever. And I get a full refund?
Yes, a full refund will be processed to your original payment method as soon as our warehouse receives the return. That usually takes about 3 to 5 business days after they get it.
Great. Another week of waiting. Is that it?
Yes, the email with the label is on its way. Was there anything else I could assist you with?
